raw_response: {"diagnosis":"raw_transactions holds 4886 rows but only 4866 distinct txn_id values, and the ids are contiguous. So about 20 rows are re-delivered copies of the same transaction, and batch 12 has a late ingest at 22:00 that looks like a replay. silver_transactions does not dedupe, so the duplicates flow into silver and then into every gold table. The fix keeps only the latest delivery per txn_id before applying the POSTED filter, so a later REVERSED version of a transaction is not kept as POSTED.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.7,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
